_doc: Which counts the plan contract can serve as a record summary (operation 'summary'): how many records of ONE whole record type exist in a stated window. A summary has no filter, unit or comparison, so only a request made of nothing but the count cue, the record's own generic name, a window and the fillers below is planned; anything else (a filter such as 'strength' or 'over 30 minutes', days instead of sessions, a metric, a second window) keeps the model's count handoff. Data, not rules: adding a record type or a name needs an entry here and a test, not decoder code.
cue: ^(?:how many|(?:the |a )?(?:total )?(?:number|count) of|what(?:'s| is) the (?:total )?(?:number|count) of|total (?:number|count) of|count(?: up)?|tally(?: up)?)\b
